newsitem.title: USA: Mazel, Value City in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Mazel, Value City in joint venture.

text.p: Mazel Stores Inc and Value City Department Stores Inc said Friday that they have signed a letter of intent to form a joint venture that will acquire and operate the toy and sporting goods departments and the health and beauty aid departments in the Value City Department Stores.
Mazel said that last year the proposed joint venture had revenues of about $110 million.

The joint venture, said the companies, is subject to numerous condition precedents, including regulatory approval and the execution of definitive agreements. They estimate that the transaction will be completed within 90 days.
Mazel is a major regional closeout retailer and one of the nation's largest wholesalers of closeout merchandise.
Value City Department Store is a full-line off-price department store chain currently operating 95 stores in the Midwest and East.
